title: Healthy Coping
subtitle: Evidence-based approaches for understanding and improving healthy coping.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports many healthy coping strategies including cognitive-behavioral techniques, exercise, and mindfulness. Emerging research continues to refine understanding of mechanisms and optimize approaches. Some evidence remains moderate regarding individual variability and long-term effects for new or less studied methods.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
